description: This file defines a Spring Boot security filter 'JwtAuthenticationFilter' that intercepts HTTP requests to validate JWT tokens from the Authorization header. It extracts the token, validates it, loads user details, and sets the authentication context for secured endpoints.

classes.name: JwtAuthenticationFilter
classes.description: A Spring Security filter that authenticates requests by validating JWT tokens from the Authorization header. It extends OncePerRequestFilter and sets the security context upon successful validation.

methods.name: JwtAuthenticationFilter
methods.description: Constructor initializing jwtTokenUtil and userDetailsService dependencies.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Overrides the filter method to extract JWT token from header, validate it, load user details, and set authentication context if valid.
